_meta.purpose: Runnable primitive adapted from OpenSRE's io-latency experiment. Simulates a service whose local work is slow (disk / DB query / GC pause). Same primitive as network-delay but applied on a service's own endpoint rather than a downstream — signals the difference between self-slow and dependency-slow.

title: [Triggered] inventory p99 latency above 1s
